newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close up for third straight session.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close up for third straight session.

text.p: Caracas stocks rose for the third straight day in moderate volume with gains led by rising blue chips seen as undervalued relative to estimated future earnings, traders said.
"Prices had fallen to attractive levels ... there was notably strong interest in Sivensa, Mavesa and Electricidad de Caracas," said InverUnion broker Hector Perez.
The bolsa's 19-share index rose 0.7 percent to close at 6,244.56 points as 22 million shares traded worth 2.8 billion bolivars ($5.9 million).
The Merinvest composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, meanwhile gained 1.1 percent to end at 96.74 points.
"Volume and interest is up, but are still relatively low as foreign investors haven't fully returned to market," said Valores broker Geronimo Paolini.
Among traded issues, 21 rose, 13 fell and eight closed flat.
